description: This file contains localization information and date parsing/formatting utilities specific to the Spanish (Paraguay) culture for the DateJS library. It defines culture info like day/month names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing dates, and extends the Date prototype with culture-specific methods.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of a date object to 00:00:00.000.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time component of the date object to the current system time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns a new Date object representing the start of today (midnight).

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two dates, returns -1, 0, or 1 depending on their chronological order.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a specific year.
